title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.75
summary: Persistente serverseitige Kameravorschauen alle 60 Sekunden; Linux Desktop Login mit Host-Port-Fix und neuem Layout.
changes: Persist one compressed JPEG per camera using the existing local HLS ring, no extra camera connections
Refresh each thumbnail every 60 seconds with globally single-flight background FFmpeg work
Serve authenticated cached thumbnails to overview and Kiosk layout editor without live probes
Fix LAN Desktop session Origin/Host checks by preserving Host with port in Nginx
Polish desktop login and checkbox layout without weakening existing authentication
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.75
description: Shared persistent camera thumbnail cache with bounded local-HLS extraction and fixed Linux Desktop sign-in Origin/Host handling.
releaseNotes: 2.20.75 stores staggered 60-second camera previews in /data/thumbnails, generated only from existing central local HLS streams. Overview and layout editor no longer probe cameras when opened; the last good JPEG survives transient outages. Nginx keeps the original Host including port so secure same-origin Desktop sign-in works on LAN addresses such as 192.168.0.231:8080. Responsive login checkbox. Existing Electron ZIP remains compatible and unchanged; credentials, recordings, camera sources and Kiosk layouts are preserved.
